mapper.insert: insert into first_comment ( first_comment_id, user_id, order_id, meal_id, meal_name, meal_content, merchant_id, comment_image_addr, comment_description ) values( #{firstCommentId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{mealId}, #{mealName}, #{mealContent}, #{merchantId}, #{commentImageAddr}, #{commentDescription} );
mapper.select: select first_comment_id, user_id, merchant_id, comment_image_addr, comment_description, create_time, like_amount, second_comment_amount from first_comment where merchant=#{merchantId} and is_delete=false order by first_comment_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select first_comment_id, user_id, order_id, meal_id, meal_name, meal_content, merchant_id, comment_image_addr, comment_description, create_time, like_amount, second_comment_amount, is_delete from first_comment where first_comment_id=#{commentId} and is_delete=false
mapper.update: update first_comment set is_delete=true where first_comment_id=#{firstCommentId} and user_id=#{userId} and is_delete=false
